answer: Slow-vesting seniority: every epoch's reward is held in escrow and vests only after 30 days of unbroken answers, building standing in layers the way a pearl grows nacre. Skip a week and the escrow is forfeited; the identity becomes a relic with nothing to claim. At about $0.04 of compute per answer and 4 epochs a day, each clone costs $4.80 up front before paying out once, so 1,000 fakes tie up $4,800 for a month while a single stylometric check at vest time, read off a crystal-clear ledger, can void the whole cluster.
